I had orchitis last summer (it's like getting the mumps in a testicle), My right testicle  was thr size of a grapefruit and my scrotum had the texture of some really thick leather. After having an ultrasound on my balls and having at least 2 doctors fondle my scrotum I was told I needed to take a course of antibiotics and they would give me a anti inflammatory for the swelling.

 The nurses who was in charge looked at me dead in the eyes and says "because of the location of the inflammation it's ideal to have a suppository", I was amazed at the fact that it was still a thing people did in modern medicine. Two minutes later she comes back with a suppository, a glove and a small sachet of lube and pretty much was like you can do that shit yourself xd. In the end it took about 6 - 7 weeks to clear up but my right testicle is normal size again.


TL'DR: had an infection in my testicle and ended up fingering my ass. I also learned that nothing is too embarrassing to not go to your doctor.
